bagPolicy.summary: Full-size backpacks are prohibited; all other bags are subject to search. The venue does not publish a numeric bag-size limit.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: A paid lot is behind the venue and may fill on busy nights; nearby paid and street parking is first come first served.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue asks riders to set pickup and drop-off at 1099 Euclid Avenue NE, Atlanta, GA 30307.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Light snacks and drinks are sold at the bar. Purchases at the venue are cashless.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The main entry is accessible and ADA viewing corrals are at the front left and right for general admission shows. Accessible stalls are on the first level; request an interpreter at least two weeks ahead.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue’s FAQ and getting-here pages do not state a rule for leaving and re-entering a ticketed show.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is open during shows and Monday–Friday from 2–6 p.m.; the venue FAQ does not specify a will-call collection process.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The main entrance at 1099 Euclid Avenue is accessible; guests pass through metal detectors. Individual concert listings give door times.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
